title: Cyrus and the Sigil
author: Yara Reyes
blurb: Theo Crane, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
